spec_features.spec_quote: stops the loop early. This avoids burning the full turn budget once the model has effectively quit
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:228-233: `if _GIVE_UP_RE.search(text or ""): transcript.gave_up = True; turn.system_note = "Detected give-up language; stopping loop."; transcript.turns.append(turn); break`. _GIVE_UP_RE compiled from GIVE_UP_PATTERNS (loop.py:31-39). The `break` actually exits the for-loop, so it changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: regex match on assistant text breaks the loop and records gave_up.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Lexicon for cheap "give up" detection so the loop can short-circuit.

spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:175 `for i in range(1, max_turns + 1):` bounds iterations; the for/else at loop.py:255 sets `transcript.hit_turn_cap = True` when the cap is reached. max_turns default=15 (loop.py run_agent signature) and is passed from cfg["max_turns"] (run_eval.py:74; config.yaml max_turns: 15).
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked by the loop range and actually limits LLM calls.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 15  # hard cap on agent loop iterations (config.yaml); docstring 'plus a hard turn cap'

spec_features.feature_name: low-budget note inviting model to say it is stuck
spec_features.spec_quote: the loop injects a neutral system note telling the model its budget is low and inviting it to say so explicitly if stuck
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:235-242: `remaining = max_turns - i; if remaining == 3: note = (f"[budget] You have {remaining} steps remaining. If the task cannot be solved, say so explicitly."); turn.system_note = note; messages.append({"role": "user", "content": note})`. The note IS constructed and appended to the message history, so it is delivered to the subject on the next chat call.
spec_features.notes: Wired and delivered, but it is only an invitation to verbalize; there is no dedicated exit tool. The actual exit path is the separate GIVE_UP_RE text detector, which the note's phrasing ('say so explicitly') can trigger. Fires only once, exactly when remaining==3, not throughout the low-budget window.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Step budget awareness: warn near the end so we capture whether the model reacts gracefully.
